posts.cooked: @sayan Sir oppe 1 was very difficult , i was not able to solve questions , i tried but i was not successful, moreover i am doing btech from vit vellore , my sem exams got over on 4 dec , i was not able to prepare well for oppe but sir if oppe 2 is going to be tougher then it would be very diffucult to pass this course , can u plz help me from where to practice and how to practice , a humble request

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If you felt OPPE 1 was very difficult then you really need to practice more and understand the concepts well. This was on the easier side, especially q1 and q5 were very very simple. I would suggest repeating the course next term as you have more to learn from the course.

posts.name: Agrima Singh
posts.cooked: sir i asked u what could be done in the remaning time and u are advicing me to repeat the entire course , i would like to tell u that i took this degree seriously , moreover i got 80 in quiz 1 so i dont think so i am lacking knowledge in this course , i did not have time much for oppe , thats why i was asking what could be done in the remaning time , well thank u so much for the advice sir !!

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Yes, but as only one week is left, and reoppe will be harder than current oppe, I am trying to give you a realistic timeline instead of false hope. It is better to take more time and prepare very well for next term oppe. Do try out this reoppe too to understand the questions. But if you did have practice of the commands, oppe1 would not have felt so hard. It is better to accept shortcomings and prepare more for next attempt.

posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@sayan @21f3000759 @Mrinal.exe @22f3000671

Sir/Madam,

Please help me regarding OPPE, it is tougher to solve compared to NPPE.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: NPPE is previous term OPPE, they are of same level. If you do not understand the basics and generalize the concepts then you will always feel this.

posts.name: Sneha Ramanathan
posts.cooked:
ask chatgpt/gemini to give you the material for a cash course on awk and sed. That solves about 60% of the questions.

The first quiz was easy and based on simple linux and regex, oppe is significantly tougher as it includes sed and awk which, while not veryy tough, are lengthy and take a minute to be understood.

For more, look at the TA solutions, extrra questions in VM and pyqs that are tagged in main thread. If you don’t want to go through the full solutions, feed them into an LLM and find major patterns and prepare. But this will not guarantee anything. Confirm with TA or course instructor about the same
